notes: Three plans shown as current offers (Flexible, Creator, Pro); the 7-day free trial is not a plan. Flexible is priced per connected platform ($6/month or $60/year each), hence 'usage' is also accepted. Yearly prices are displayed as totals ($190, $390) on the pricing page and as '$190 a year' on the home page. The free link-in-bio page is a free side tool, not a plan; because of it pricing_status is left unannotated (paid vs freemium is debatable). The home-page comparison table lists competitor prices (Buffer, ManyChat, etc.): those are not Hypefury plans. Facebook (Pages) is also a stated publishing platform but left out to respect the 6-integration cap. 'Hypefury started in 2019' is annotated as launch_year (product start); founded_year is neither expected nor forbidden because the sentence could be read either way. '7 humans' on the About page is read as a team of 7 (employee_min = employee_max = 7) - product owner to confirm. 'Hypefury, Inc.' does not state a country, so country_code is forbidden. 'App in 18 languages' is stated but the languages are not listed (the footer is the website language switcher), so languages is not annotated. Footer 'Affiliate program' link is incidental: the core product is social-media content creation and scheduling, so eligible.
